title: Agent Seer: Synthesizing Scenarios from Specification Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.26133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating AI agents that use external tools requires realistic test scenarios that capture how practitioners compose tools and iterate across conversation turns. Constructing such scenarios by hand demands deep domain expertise, does not scale across tool ecosystems, and produces static benchmarks that cannot track evolving APIs. We observe that tool specifications -- function names, natural-language descriptions, and typed parameter schemas -- already encode sufficient semantic information to synthesize realistic evaluation scenarios without manual curation or live tool execution. Agent Seer builds off this latent information: from a single Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification, with no examples, no live tool access, and no domain-specific tuning. This pipeline enriches raw schemas, generates graded scenarios with synthetic tool outputs, and expands them into mock-data-grounded multi-turn dialogues that exhibit strong tool-calling

translated_title: Agent Seer：从规格理解中合成场景
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26133v1 公告类型：新 摘要：评估使用外部工具的AI代理，需要能够捕捉实践者如何组合工具并在对话轮次中迭代的真实测试场景。手工构建此类场景需要深厚的领域专业知识，无法跨工具生态系统扩展，并且产生的静态基准无法跟踪不断演变的API。我们观察到，工具规格——函数名称、自然语言描述和类型化参数模式——已经编码了足够的语义信息，无需人工策展或实时工具执行即可合成逼真的评估场景。Agent Seer利用这一潜在信息：从单一的模型上下文协议（MCP）规格出发，无需示例、无需实时工具访问、无需领域特定调优。该流程丰富原始模式，生成带有合成工具输出的分级场景，并将其扩展为基于模拟数据的多轮对话，展现出强大的工具调用能力。
tldr: Agent Seer仅从单一MCP工具规格中自动合成逼真的多轮评估场景，无需人工干预、示例或实时工具访问，显著提升了AI代理评估的可扩展性和适应性。
en_tdlr: Agent Seer automatically synthesizes realistic multi-turn evaluation scenarios from a single MCP tool specification without manual curation, examples, or live tool access, significantly enhancing scalability and adaptability in AI agent assessment.
